message.content: {"summary": "Inbound call from Tom Keller of Brightline Facilities seeking a replacement extract fan for a 90 m² meeting room with 25 occupants, 250 mm duct, 18 m run, BMS control, and noise sensitivity. follow‑up call to review", "due": "2026-10-15", "owner": "manager"}, "criteria": {"greeting": {"score": 2, "evidence": ["U1"], "comment": "Manager names company (Northwind Air) and herself (Anna) at the start."}, "discovery": {"score": 2, "evidence": ["U3", "U5", "U7", "U9", "U11"], "comment": "Asks room size/occupancy (U3), duct size and run (U5), noise concern (U7), control method (U9), and deadline (U11) before recommending."}, "recommendation": {"score": 2, "evidence": ["U13", "U15"], "comment": "Recommends specific NW‑ID‑250E EC fan matching airflow, pressure, spigot size, and BMS control; {"summary": "Manager Leo Grant called Daniel Ruiz at Mercato Foods to follow up on a quote for eight rectangular fans for cold store extraction. The customer mentioned a competitor offer 12% lower, and the manager offered a 15% discount and guaranteed delivery by Thursday. The customer agreed to sign the revised quote today.", "customer_need": "Needs eight rectangular fans (60-35) for cold store extraction with competitive pricing and delivery by Friday for Monday installation.", "outcome": "quote_requested", "next_step": {"action": "Send revised quote with 15% discount", "due": "2026-10-12", "owner": "manager"}, "criteria": {"greeting": {"score": 2, "evidence": ["U2"], "comment": "Manager names himself, company, and reason for calling (follow-up on quote for eight rectangular fans)."}, "discovery": {"score": 0, "evidence": ["U4"], "comment": "Manager only asks which models the competitor offered; does not ask about application, size, airflow, constraints, or deadline before responding with a discount."}, "recommendation": {"score": 0, "evidence": ["U6", "U10"], "comment": "No new product recommendation tied to customer needs; manager simply confirms the existing quote and offers a discount without linking to any discovered requirements."}, "objections": {"score": 0, "evidence": ["U6", "U8"], "comment": "Customer raises price and delivery concerns; manager gives an unapproved 15% discount and guarantees Thursday delivery without checking stock or providing alternatives."}, "closing": {"score": 2, "evidence": ["U11", "U12"], "comment": "Concrete next step agreed: manager will send revised quote within the hour (today), customer will sign today."}, "listening": {"score": 2, "evidence": ["U4", "U8", "U10"], "comment": "Manager lets customer finish, responds politely, and confirms details (e.g., 'Yes, all eight'). No interruptions or dismissiveness."}, "compliance": {"score": 0, "evidence": ["U6", "U8"], "comment": "Manager offers 15% discount without head of sales approval (exceeds 5% limit) and promises delivery by Thursday without verifying stock status."}}, "red_flags": [{"type": "unapproved_discount", "utterance": "U6", "note": "Manager offers 15% discount without head of sales approval."}, {"type": "delivery_promise", "utterance": "U8", "note": "Manager guarantees delivery by Thursday without confirming stock availability."}], "coaching": "Before offering discounts or delivery dates, complete proper discovery and verify stock/approval limits; handle price objections with value justification or approved alternatives rather than immediate concessions."}

{"summary": "Martin Shaw, chief engineer at Oakridge Hotels, called inbound about a rattling NW-RF-400E roof fan supplied in August. Manager Priya Shah diagnosed a possible loose mounting from recent roof work, scheduled a free warranty service visit for Wednesday 8:30 AM, and gave a temporary BMS workaround.
